title: Rich McKay: Owners have appetite for more replay assist, we just don’t want to move too fast

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Rich McKay: Owners have appetite for more replay assist, we just don’t want to move too fast
sources.description: The NFL approved a plan on Tuesday to expand replay assistance, allowing the league at the command center in New York to drop a flag when considering a disqualification for a flagrant football act and a non-football act that was not called on the field.
